convert_pixart_checkpoint: convert a PixArt-Sigma checkpoint to Diffusers format by remapping state dict keys and saving the pipeline
run_pixart_conversion: run the conversion script with --orig_ckpt_path and --dump_path to transform a PixArt checkpoint for Diffusers
convert_with_micro_condition: convert a PixArt-Sigma checkpoint with micro-conditioning support for resolution and aspect ratio embedders
convert_with_qk_norm: convert a PixArt-Sigma checkpoint with QK normalization enabled for attention layers
save_transformer_only: save only the converted Transformer2DModel weights without the full pipeline components like VAE and tokenizer
